attchmntText: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Classification of US FDA Inspection at Lannett Company LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma USA, Inc.
voiceSummary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited informs the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited that the United States Food and Drug Administration has classified the inspection of its wholly owned subsidiary, Lannett Company LLC, located in Seymour, Indiana, as official action indicated. The inspection took place from 17th to 21st August 2026. The US FDA issued four observations during the inspection, which the company responded to within the stipulated time. The company states that there is no impact on its financials or operations due to this action. The company commits to maintaining robust quality and compliance standards and will keep the stock exchanges informed of any further developments.

attchmntText: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings call with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The call, held on November 5, 2026, covered the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported record revenue of 10,263 crores, a 24% year-on-year increase. Operating EBITDA was 2,156 crores, up 28% year-on-year, with a margin of 21%. Profit after tax stood at 1,124 crores. Key developments included the completion of the Lannett acquisition and the launch of the ADQUEY product. The company reiterated its FY27 guidance for double-digit revenue growth, EBITDA margins north of 21%, and absolute EBITDA exceeding 8,000 crore. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Apitoria Unit 2, an API manufacturing facility of Apitoria Pharma Private Limited., a subsidiary of the Company, receives Establishment Inspection Report from US FDA with classification as  Voluntary Action Indicated
voiceSummary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited reports that Apitoria Unit 2, an API manufacturing facility of its wholly owned subsidiary Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, received an Establishment Inspection Report from the US FDA. The inspection took place from September 7th to September 15th, 2026, at the facility in Sangareddy District, Telangana. The US FDA classified the facility as Voluntary Action Indicated. The FDA has concluded that the inspection is closed under 21 CFR 20.64(d)(3). This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited announces that its officials will participate in the INDX 2026 Avendus Spark Annual India Conference on November 17, 2026, from 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM IST in Mumbai. The event includes one-on-one and group meetings with investors and analysts. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed during these interactions.
